facts.summary: Initial Phase 1 data showed modest responses, none in low-expression patients · Phase 1 · EO-3021 in Claudin 18.2 gastric/GEJ cancer · not yet approved
facts.indication: Claudin 18.2-expressing gastric, gastroesophageal junction, pancreatic or esophageal solid tumors

evidence.summary: In seven patients with Claudin 18.2 in ≥20% of tumor cells at IHC 2+/3+, the objective response rate (ORR) was 42.8% (three confirmed partial responses
evidence.safety: EO-3021 was observed to be generally well-tolerated. No neutropenia or peripheral neuropathy/hypoesthesia, both known toxicities associated with monomethyl auristatin E (MMAE), were observed in the safety population of 32 patients treated with EO-3021.
